subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should assistant reasoning and tool activity be enabled by default and persisted for existing macOS chat users?
rationale: The PR adds a cross-launch default-on preference that changes the information shown in existing users' native chat; source review cannot determine the intended product default.

options.title: Default off
options.body: Ship the toggle disabled by default so users explicitly opt into assistant reasoning and tool activity.

options.title: Default on
options.body: Keep the proposed default-on behavior and explicitly accept the changed existing-user experience.

recommendation.title: Default off
recommendation.body: Ship the toggle disabled by default so users explicitly opt into assistant reasoning and tool activity.

likelyOwner.reason: The available native-app history and protected maintainer context make this the best available owner for the macOS product-default decision.
